message.content:
<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
Now that I have read both Priya's and Marcus's calendars, I need to consolidate their schedules to find mutually available times. I'll go through each day of the week and identify all 30-minute slots between 9:00 AM and 5:00 PM where neither of them has a scheduled event. Once I have this list of possible meeting times, I will post it to the shared workspace for Brad to review. This will allow him to check the availability of Elena and David for these specific times.
</SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
